title: Appeal of Jack Mayfield v. Siouxlands Presbytery
disposition_detail: The Assembly adopted the recommendation finding the appeal not in order under BCO 42-4 because it was filed nearly eighteen months after adjudication; Mayfield was directed to BCO 37-4's procedure for removing censure.
first_summary: The Assembly found Jack Mayfield's appeal not in order under BCO 42-4 because he filed it nearly a year and a half after the matter had been adjudicated, and his reasons did not justify disregarding the filing requirement. The ruling did not reach the underlying merits and directed him instead to BCO 37-4's procedure for removing censure.
